statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for underlying paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The diagnosis is I49.9 (unspecified cardiac arrhythmia)
The procedure code billed is 93226 (48-hour Holter monitoring)
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The 48-hour Holter monitoring study is medically necessary to capture potential arrhythmic events that may be missed on shorter monitoring
